_comment: Shared HTML for the navigation entries that the site build adds to the pages (site/patches/*.json refer to these by name). {{name}} is replaced by the parameter of that name; {{#name}}...{{/name}} is kept only when the parameter is true; {{target}} is the link to the page named by the parameter `page` (route or file name, following linkStyle in site.json) plus the optional parameter `fragment`; {{link:KEY}} is the link to the page KEY. Parameters come from the step and from the named entry below. Values are inserted as HTML, unescaped: this file is trusted data. Format: site/patches/README.md
